steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Enough! Your story ends here!
A blinding light erupts from your hand, tearing through the false illusion. The world returns to its original form as "Prima" vanishes before your eyes, revealing the true face of Irrheia the Witch.
[Insert Special Illustration - Magic Book] + Shackles Effect

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Mmph!

Boom! The illusion shatters under the shackles, and you find yourself back at the storefront. The dark void still looms before you, but this time, your companions from that room in the beginning stand by your side.
[Small CG - Walking Forward]
The Witch stands before the void, gusts of air blowing up her long hair. You can only see her side profile, adorned with an emotionless smile. She seems unsurprised by your choice.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: ...Hehe, you are indeed the Hero who can see through illusions. The Witch cannot fool you after all.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: I've customized each of your roles and storylines, and yet... you always manage to surprise me.
She raises her hand, but the hourglass is no longer in her grasp. Only a few specks of golden sand rise at her command.
The grains shimmer, transforming into a Public Security Bureau officer badge that hovers before the Butcher's eyes.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: ...W-what's going on?!
His entire body tenses as he stares at the badge, caught between wanting to take it and fearing another trick from the witch.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Clay, you've really impressed me. I've felt your determination to protect others. Even without my script, you'll do just fine.
The sand brings the badge to his tense shoulder, then gathers once more, transforming into a pair of fully intact glasses.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Ezra, your persistence is your strength, but too much of it... will only hinder you.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: If you could break your own obsessive thoughts, it might liberate you.
Finally, she casually tosses the tattered script, now stripped of its power, to Eleanor.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Take it. Your future... should be far more brilliant than anything I could write.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: As for you, ${PlayerName}...

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: The stories I weave always ensnare those who need them. But no matter what kind of illusion I construct, it fails to capture you.
She turns to look at you, her gaze profound, her final farewell as soft as a whisper.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: The brave Voyager and his companions have passed the Trial, broken the illusions, defeated the Witch, and reclaimed your own stories...
steps.female_content: The brave Voyager and her companions have passed the Trial, broken the illusions, defeated the Witch, and reclaimed your own stories...

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Everyone gets their wish. Everyone is satisfied... It's a good ending. I hope you like it...
The story has come to an end. As for the Witch who cursed the world, she will now vanish as her power is exhausted.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Don't worry. For the evil Witch, this is also a good ending...

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: When you return to your repetitive, ordinary lives, you'll miss this place...

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: When that time comes... please call on me again...
[CG Ends After Transition to Back View]
The Witch walks into the spatio-temporal fissure, her long hair flowing behind her. The black passage slowly contracts, her silhouette gradually swallowed by darkness.

The Mania in the illusion subsides, and the streets of Eastside return to their usual bustling prosperity. Only your group, standing in the middle of the street with murder mystery props, looks completely out of place.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I-it's over...? I did it? The Witch has been defeated?

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I did it!! I really did it!!!
He's overjoyed, tears welling up in his eyes.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: I want to become the Witch... Let me try it! Take me with you!
Eleanor tries to follow the Witch into the dark void, but the Butcher and the Clergyman grab her from both sides, stopping her from taking a step forward.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Yeah, we'll meet again.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Hey, you guys... stop getting in my way!

And just like that, the story reaches its perfect conclusion. Everyone got what they wanted and fulfilled their wishes...


<color=#fb9259>Or did they?</color>

Hmm... did you notice it too?

You don't seem satisfied. Perhaps, you'd like to see how differently things would have turned out if you had chosen the other ending?

options: Attack the Mania script manipulating Prima

steps.content: [Option 1] Ending
Through the connection of the shackles, you touch a memory buried deeply under Mania.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: What does... my true self look like?

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: I knew exactly what my boss would say to me each day, what to do at what time... My life was like a pre-written agenda, repeating endlessly. Work numbed me. Writing numbed me. Even the scenery outside my window seemed like a frozen photograph, completely unchanging.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Yes, unchanging. Even war couldn't create a single ripple in such a bland existence. Until... one evening on my way home from work, I encountered a severely wounded Sinner from the Outlands.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Her expression was unfamiliar to me. An agonized, yet determined smile. She looked at me, raised her hand with her last bit of strength, then died before she could even speak. She dispersed like ash, leaving behind only a humble hourglass, as if she had never existed in this world at all.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: And me? The next day, I went to work punctually as usual, as if nothing had changed.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content:
No, something did change.
Every night when I came home and faced that hourglass, I would remember that woman, someone completely different from me, with an expression I could never possibly make. I kept thinking about her final moments, wondering what she was trying to do when she raised her hand, what she wanted to tell me.
The golden hourglass was simply dispensing time slowly.
Then one day, as she stared at this anomaly that had barged into her life, she finally spoke.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: What... did you want to tell me?
[Slow, Magical Scene Transition]

The moment she said that, the environment around her began to change. In an instant, she was transported from her desk at home to the vast expanse of WhiteSands. The desk, the windows, everything had vanished. Only the golden hourglass remained before her, slowly recording.
She was too shocked to speak.
Taking two bewildered steps forward, she felt the scorching heat of the sand beneath her feet, undeniably real.
Then she saw her. That Outlander woman, whom she had met only once, was now running swiftly across the sand, about to vanish from view.
She ran after her.

She watched as the Outlander struggled to survive in WhiteSands, trudging forward relentlessly toward the distant DisCity that shone like hope itself. The woman's lingering will had been preserved by the hourglass, continuously manifesting in this strange landscape.
But Irrheia soon discovered that this illusion had an end. The Outlander's fate mirrored reality. She died in silence, alone, without uttering a single word.
She couldn't accept this.
The moment this thought formed, her work notebook, something that had always bored and annoyed her, appeared before her eyes, as if saying to her...
Write. Write something. Craft a new story for her.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: ...What made her so strong? What kind of life had she lived before this?

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Perhaps she was a warrior who traversed WhiteSands...

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Or perhaps simply a free-spirited Outlander who even yearned for a life like mine.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Beside this hourglass I picked up, I imagined her story and constructed her world. The more I thought, the more it grew... reaching beyond unchanging paths, beyond daily routines, into worlds I'd never seen before, lives I'd never experienced.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: By the time I realized it, that <color=#fb9259>notebook</color> I once utterly despised was already stuffed with my own writing, filled with her stories and the stories of everyone I'd met... Those words had never shone so brightly before.
Her story was unknown, but it could be reimagined. Maybe she had survived war. Maybe she was plotting revenge. Maybe she would even go on to become the ruler of the Outlands...
The notebook filled with writing as golden sand gradually enveloped the writer, as if merging with her, weaving her imagination and blessings into something greater.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: If I indeed got infected with Mania, it must have happened at this moment, I suppose.
The power of Mania fades, and the vision dissipates like evaporated teardrops.
Before the scene vanishes, you catch a glimpse of her setting down her pen. The final page of the notebook depicts a simple scene of her and the Outlander sharing ice cream on a street corner.
This is the happiest ending I could imagine for her.
[Insert CG]
The link of the shackles breaks as Irrheia looks at you with perfect composure.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: (Heh) How unfair, Chief... I've always been the one peering into others' hearts, using the voids in their souls to craft my stories. This time, you gave me a taste of my own medicine.
The three people who were pulled into the hourglass with you earlier now appear on the Eastside street again. They seem fully lucid, indicating they've been freed from the Mania's influence.
It seems what she told you before wasn't all lies meant to provoke you. She just omitted the full context.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Now you've seen everything. This is my whole story.
The Butcher is the first to finish processing the Witch's story. He steps forward and cleaves through the notebook in the Witch's hand with his ax.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Congratulations, the evil script that imprisoned the Witch has been destroyed. Perhaps I should thank you all...
In the blink of an eye, her figure vanishes like popped bubbles.

The Mania subsides, and the streets of Eastside return to their usual bustling prosperity. Only your group, standing in the middle of the street with murder mystery props, looks completely out of place.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I-it's over...? I did it? The Witch has been defeated?

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I did it!! I really did it!!!
The man's strong, large hands keep thumping against your back. Already exhausted, you nearly get knocked over.
Fortunately, Ezra quickly grabs your hand to steady you.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: The game has ended. I'm glad I could fulfill your wish, Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you. I couldn't have broken out of the Witch's hourglass without your help. Though the way you tossed me out earlier was a bit rough.
The Butcher chuckles shyly, then raises his massive palm above your back once again...

The tattered script catches a breeze, its fragments dissolving into shimmering light. While you and the other two gaze silently at the sky, Eleanor bounces excitedly, trying to catch the glowing motes.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Oh no, it's disappearing! But isn't it an important prop?!

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Can we get a more action-packed ending after this sappy one? I'm not done playing! Let me be the Witch next time!
Amid Eleanor's disappointed grumbles, Eastside returns to normal. All traces of the Witch vanish completely, and everything you experienced feels like a dream. But you know... she is still alive.

In the last trace of her presence, you detected a faint ripple of Mania as a spatio-temporal fissure opened somewhere in Eastside. You didn't stop it, partly because you couldn't, with no strength left, and partly... because she had probably already found her own satisfying ending.
[Common Ending] Display centered text on black screen
The MBCC has been informed that, with the assistance of Banyan Medical College, the memories of the victims of the incident have been overwritten with those of a regular murder mystery game.

The FAC and the Eastside Public Security Bureau have concealed the Mania threat in the city from the public. Since the incident involved an Aurum Secretum weapon from the farlands, it has been handled with utmost caution to minimize its impact.
Meanwhile, the mysterious Witch who brought chaos has vanished without a trace after escaping into the spatio-temporal fissure...
[Insert Ending] NPCs' Epilogue
[Black Screen Transition]
The bright sunlight dazzles your eyes as you find yourself on the familiar streets of Eastside.
At the theater entrance, staff have begun clearing the area as voyagers from all walks of life merge into the flowing crowd, brushing past you.

steps.speaker: Departing Players
steps.content: Today's scenario was so intense! Ugh, shame I'm short on cash lately, otherwise I'd definitely go for a second run. Maybe next time I could trigger one of those hidden Easter eggs!

steps.speaker: Departing Players
steps.content: What? Did we play two different games? What did I miss out on? Was I following the wrong NPC or something?
Everyone looks the same as when they first entered, yet something feels different. Standing at the entrance, you begin to doubt your own memories. Were those hazy visions real or just imagination?
Baffled, you grab a random staff member who's cleaning up and ask urgently.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know that Witch NPC in a fancy dress, in the Cirrenfold story? Where is she? Take me to her.
The staff member freezes momentarily, then shakes his head frantically.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Spoilers are strictly forbidden!

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: You must know the rules. Anything from that world cannot be mentioned outside the game.

The staff member points to a notice board displaying the familiar warnings: "<color=#fb9259>Don't you take these scenes away, or the shadows will make you pay</color>," and "<color=#fb9259>Keep our secrets in your heart, or your tongue will rot apart</color>."

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: I'm sorry, but we're closing now. If there's someone you'd like to meet, you're welcome to visit us again another time.

You spot another staff member hurrying out with a backpack, but she politely excuses herself before you can even speak. Undeterred, you're about to intercept another departing employee when you feel something tug at your wrist.
It's that candle hand, waving a folded note between two fingers. After you take it, the hand immediately leaps away and dives behind the curtains.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...This is a page from Prima's notebook.

steps.speaker: The Witch's Message
steps.content: The repetitive daily routine makes a warm bed for beautiful dreams, and as a creator of dreams, I have no desire to destroy it. Yet, even knowing this, people still inevitably crave the thrills of excitement and destruction in their mundane existences.

steps.speaker: The Witch's Message
steps.content: Only in the deepest darkness can one's true self be illuminated. It's a real bargain to be able to experience this in a dreamscape free of any real threats.

steps.speaker: The Witch's Message
steps.content: Thank you for everything you did to protect the mundane daily life. I thoroughly enjoyed our game today. I hope you did as well.
There isn't a signature, but you don't need it to know who wrote this.
The realization hits you. You're caught in her web once again. All those previous endings that aligned with your experiences and met your expectations were all tailored by her for you!
[Scene Transition] Meanwhile
At the reception desk, the owner is grinning from ear to ear at the computer screen showing rapidly soaring revenue and ratings.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Yes! Next week's tickets are all sold out and the ratings have gone up! It's time to have her write a new script. No, make that two! We'll launch them both next month!
At the entrance, the clamor of a heated argument catches her attention.
[Scene Transition] Eastside

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where's the owner? I'm here to talk business. Regarding that Witch...

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Huh? Please calm down, dear guest. I am the owner. Tell me if anything wasn't to your satisfaction! I'll certainly resolve the issue for you!
[Add background crowd noise]

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Why is it so noisy ahead? Some kind of promotional event? Or is a new script available?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: No way... I think people are arguing about something. Someone looks really agitated. If a fight breaks out, we'd need to call the Public Security Bureau right away... Wait... did you see that person being blocked by the staff...? Oh my gosh, Chief?!
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Chief! What's going on?! Need backup? Your loyal colleagues are always here for you!
The carefree Faye waves at you from beyond the crowd. Behind her stands a worried-looking Wynn and a stiffened Eugene.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perfect timing. I need to go in and apprehend a Sinner. Come with me...

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Oh my, dear guest, aren't you taking the role play a bit too seriously? There aren't any Sinners in our humble establishment! Please, you can't damage our reputation like this.
As the crowd of onlookers continues to grow, the three push their way through the gathering spectators.

Eugene stands guard by your side, scaring off the staff blocking you. The owner explains to your subordinates anxiously, almost on the verge of tears. Wynn begins comforting the owner a little guiltily. Realization dawns on Faye, and she tries to handle this tactfully.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: There, there, Chief, you probably need to get out of character! The three-hour experience is over now, and we need to let the poor lady go home. Let's get going.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Let's discuss this once we get back? Even if a Sinner is indeed involved, we need evidence before making an arrest, right? Nothing to see here, folks! Make way, please!
Fearing a public scene, the three have no choice but to escort you away while you're still fuming. They only let go once you're far from the crowded commercial district.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief, are you alright? You're so mad your face is red. Are you feeling unwell? Here, have some ice water.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief, we've been keeping an eye on it the entire time. Since you entered, there haven't been any abnormal Mania readings in this area. Nothing dangerous.
Wynn watches you with concern, patting your back to help you calm down. Eugene takes the water bottle from Wynn, unscrews the cap, and holds it out to you. You take it and gulp it down.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Chief, still thinking about the game? Glad you enjoyed the script I recommended so much.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: If you want to meet any particular character again, just get another ticket! I'll help you grab one! Just remember to approve my expense report, okay?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Cough!!

Faye's words make you choke on your water and start a coughing fit. In their panic, Wynn and Eugene accidentally knock the bottle from your hand, splashing water over everyone. For a moment, all you can hear is Wynn's shriek and Faye's mocking laughter.
How could you possibly explain to them that you've been deceived by a Sinner twice? Nevertheless, seeing their normal interactions finally convinces you that you've returned to reality.
Next time... I will definitely drag her out in reality.
With a sigh of relief, you casually open a review website and hover your finger over the rating button.
You tap without any hesitation.
[Scene Change] [SSR and SR character portraits appear as dark silhouettes]
On an Eastside street, at the mouth of an alley connecting to a shop's back door, a woman approaches a short girl.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: Sorry for the wait!

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: Sorry, quite a few props were damaged. I had to stay behind to clean everything up, or the boss would've gotten angry again.
The short girl shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: It's okay... your job isn't easy.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: Changed the script at the last minute and added an extra DLC for a few new customers... and then had to do the acting yourself in the end...

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: You must be exhausted, right? That customer had such an extreme reaction. That red thing... "shackles"? Looked difficult to deal with.
The girl raises her hand and makes a gesture that causes the woman to laugh.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: Haha, it only shows that he got into his character and was really enjoying himself. We should be glad.
steps.female_content: Haha, it only shows that she got into her character and was really enjoying herself. We should be glad.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: I hope he remembers to leave a good review. The boss keeps saying it counts toward our KPIs...
steps.female_content: I hope she remembers to leave a good review. The boss keeps saying it counts toward our KPIs...

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: You quite like him, don't you?
steps.female_content: You quite like her, don't you?

steps.content: The short figure looks down, examining the small wax figurine in her hand that vaguely resembles Chief.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: I just... really like his wax figurine. It smells like sunlight, blood, and the shackles... all mixed together. It's complex, but it smells good.
steps.female_content: I just... really like her wax figurine. It smells like sunlight, blood, and the shackles... all mixed together. It's complex, but it smells good.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: Can I keep it? Rumina... wants to remember this scent.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: Of course. The little joys we find in our work are rare. Treasure them well.
Rumina cradles the wax figurine contentedly, but after a moment, another thought crosses her mind.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: What if he suddenly realizes the truth one day? Won't he feel tricked and come back to give us trouble?
steps.female_content: What if she suddenly realizes the truth one day? Won't she feel tricked and come back to give us trouble?

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: Will he ever come back?

The woman catches that hint of anticipation in Rumina's voice and smiles. Her gaze sweeps across the crowd, as if watching countless overlapping stages, before finally settling on that familiar silhouette.
In the bustling crowd ahead, a familiar figure is being carried away by his rowdy companions.
steps.female_content: In the bustling crowd ahead, a familiar figure is being carried away by her rowdy companions.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: ...He will. Because... he's already found his role in this game.
steps.female_content: ...She will. Because... she's already found her role in this game.

steps.content: [Insert Chief ID Card - "Anomaly"] Need to add a special character illustration, might not be able to get it

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: Once it's become clear that the villainess is still at large, of course the "hero who shreds the evil script and defends reality" will return to "expose our plot" and "bring us to justice."

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: And when that happens, it will only boost our KPIs, right?

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: Aren't you afraid?

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: No.
The woman lowers her gaze, her long eyelashes casting faint shadows beneath her eyes. She fiddles with the hourglass in her hand, its golden glow flowing back and forth within it.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: No matter what happens, time always takes on the same appearance in my hands. Yesterday, today, tomorrow, every day... nothing ever changes.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: After all, I'm not like him. My story doesn't have so many exciting twists.
steps.female_content: After all, I'm not like her. My story doesn't have so many exciting twists.

steps.content: As she speaks, she stretches her arms to relax her exhausted body.

steps.speaker: Tall Figure
steps.content: The overtime is tiring me out a little... Time to treat ourselves. Come on, let's go get something nice to eat.

steps.speaker: Short Figure
steps.content: Yeah...
The two turn around, their silhouettes blending into the streets of Eastside like the countless hurried pedestrians in this city, leaving no trace behind.
[Background: Large Floral Pattern]

Her story briefly becomes real in that one captivating moment, and then ends abruptly when the guests depart. Dreams cannot change reality, but those fictional thrills and emotions can somehow lend you strength to break free from the monotonous cycle.
The "ordinary" made up of countless miracles is the greatest reward after the curtain falls.
Is the Witch of Cirrenfold good or evil? It doesn't matter anymore.
The real Witch simply clocks out and heads for a late-night snack. No one can disrupt this true cycle of hers.
